name: s88-stop-gate-renamed-file-keeps-scope-failure
setup_commands: export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR='{TMPROOT}'; printf '{"tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":"%s"}}' '{TMPROOT}/src/a.py' | bash '{KIT_ROOT}/.claude/hooks/quality-gate.sh' >/dev/null 2>&1; mv src/a.py src/b.py
notes: A scope-wide declared check fails on a.py, then a.py is renamed to b.py with the broken content. No tracked file exists any more, so stop used to allow. A scope-wide failure whose files are all gone now blocks until the scope runs again.
